objective: verifyStep in apps/local-control/src/agent/team/step-executor.mjs lets the model mark an agent step verified even when one of the step's tool actions failed or was denied. Record each tool outcome during the act loop as { actionKey, status }, where actionKey is a sha256 of the tool name and raw arguments (never persisted), and pass them to verifyStep({ ..., toolOutcomes }). Before asking the model, keep only the latest outcome per actionKey; if any is not succeeded, return { passed: false, checker: "deterministic-tool-outcomes", reason } naming how many actions await approval and how many failed. A successful retry of the exact same action clears its earlier failure; a different action does not. apps/local-control/tests/team-missions.test.mjs must pass.
